# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:
  `orphanReportKey` (canonical id + tool + timestamp) latches in
  `Agent.reportedOrphanKeys`; hosts persist each first-time batch as the
  hidden `orphan_report` custom record and seed the latch back at resume

  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit

  optional-field backward-compatible); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run
  position-counter ids session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s
  `_localTrimFallback` routes the kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`

  (I3), each in-place image carrying its `[Image N]` label (issue #195
  F3 — the model can cite what it sees); the per-request cap

    None propagates: an unreadable stream must not fabricate a zero (the
    audit then just omits the field).

    Byte accounting splits on `'\\n'` only (reproducible against `wc -c`):
    a matched line counts its full bytes — a `\\r` stays in the line — plus
    exactly the one newline it ends with, and a final unterminated line
    counts without the newline. `str.splitlines()` would also split on
    `\\r`, `\\v`, `\\x85`, … and silently miscount against the byte total.
    """
    if stream is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(stream, bytes):
        stream = stream.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    total = 0
    lines = stream.split("\n")
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if _is_liveness_line(line):
            total += len(line.encode("utf-8"))
            if index < len(lines) - 1:
                total += 1  # the newline this line ends with
    return total

# FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS into the agent session so fa can shift into
# wrap-up (land partial results, drain background jobs, run its checks)

# - the deadline comes ONLY from the adapter's own effective kill cap
#   minus a wrap-up margin — never invented, never extended; with no

#   invisible to the adapter) fa's deadline awareness stays OFF;
# - the margin exists so the wrap-up turn completes before the kill —
#   a deadline at the cap itself would steer fa into its own SIGKILL.
_DEADLINE_MARGIN_SEC = 120.0
# A tiny configured cap must still leave fa a wrap-up window: the
# deadline is clamped to at least this much remaining time rather than
# landing in the past.
_DEADLINE_MIN_REMAINING_SEC = 30.0


def effective_cap_sec(knobs: TimeoutKnobs, test_budget_sec: float = 0.0) -> float:
    """The adapter's own kill cap — the only honest deadline source.

    Progress-watch mode: the flat abs ceiling (+ the caller's test
    budget where one is folded in, as tb does NOT — it leaves the
    verifier phase to the harness). Legacy progress-aware ladder: the
    byte-growth hard ceiling. Flat ladder: the flat base cap.
    """
    if knobs.progress_watch:
        return knobs.watch_abs_ceiling_sec + test_budget_sec
    if knobs.progress_extension:
        return knobs.ceiling_sec
    return knobs.base_sec


def deadline_epoch_ms(
    knobs: TimeoutKnobs | None,
    now_ms: int,
    test_budget_sec: float = 0.0,
    margin_sec: float = _DEADLINE_MARGIN_SEC,
) -> int | None:
    """Epoch-ms deadline for fa's FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS, or None when off.

    deterministic and unit-testable. None propagates the "no adapter cap

class DeadlineEnvTest(unittest.TestCase):

    The deadline comes ONLY from the adapter's own kill cap minus a

    export is absent and fa's deadline awareness stays off.

    def test_no_knobs_means_no_deadline(self):

    def test_watch_mode_deadline_is_abs_ceiling_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        # 3600s abs ceiling - 120s wrap-up margin.
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 3480_000,

        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_env_from(env, now_ms),

            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="600", FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000

        self.assertEqual(

Reading again: "(i.e. clip against the step-env ceiling when present, otherwise default the ceiling to base × 4 — precisely what the legacy ladder would have used.)" So the form is: if ceiling set, clip (min), else default to base×4. So:

```bash
export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="${FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC:-$((AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4))}"

Or combine. The simplest robust form preserving both semantics:

```bash
ceiling="${FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC:-$((AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4))}"
export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( ceiling < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? ceiling : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"

Hmm, but that single line alone doesn't clip when the ceiling is present (3600 < 600*4=2400 would need min → 2400). E.g., AGENT_TIMEOUT=600, ceiling=3600 present → line leaves 3600, but the clip intent is min(3600, 2400)=2400. # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call

  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.

class DeadlineEnvTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1556 AC7: FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS for fa's deadline awareness.

    The deadline comes ONLY from the adapter's own kill cap minus a
    wrap-up margin — never invented; with no adapter cap (no knobs) the
    export is absent and fa's deadline awareness stays off.
    """

    def test_no_knobs_means_no_deadline(self):
        self.assertIsNone(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(None, 1_700_000_000_000)
        )
        self.assertEqual(fa_agent_timeout.deadline_env_from(clean_env_all()), {})

    def test_watch_mode_deadline_is_abs_ceiling_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        # 3600s abs ceiling - 120s wrap-up margin.
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 3480_000,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_env_from(env, now_ms),
            {"FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS": str(now_ms + 3480_000)},
        )

    def test_legacy_extension_deadline_is_hard_ceiling_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="600", FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        # Hard ceiling = 600 * 4 = 2400s; minus 120s margin.
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 2280_000,
        )

    def test_flat_cap_deadline_is_base_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="600")
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 480_000,
        )

    def test_tiny_cap_clamps_to_a_remaining_window(self):
        # A 60s cap minus the 120s margin would land in the past — the
        # deadline clamps to a minimal wrap-up window instead of steering
        # fa into an already-expired clock.
        env = clean_env_all(FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="60")
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 30_000,
        )

    def test_test_budget_folds_into_the_watch_cap(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(
                knobs, now_ms, test_budget_sec=300.0
            ),
            now_ms + 3780_000,
        )

    def test_audit_records_the_fa_visible_deadline(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        watch = fa_agent_timeout.ProgressWatch(knobs)
        record = audit_dict(knobs, watch, "abs_ceiling", deadline_epoch_ms=42)
        self.assertEqual(record["deadline_epoch_ms"], 42)

    def test_audit_omits_deadline_when_unset(self):
        # No-knob runs keep the pre-gh-1556 audit shape byte-for-byte.
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs(base_sec=120.0)
        ladder = ProgressLadder(knobs)
        record = audit_dict(knobs, ladder, "stall")
        self.assertNotIn("deadline_epoch_ms", record)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

ENV_TYPE: ${{ matrix.env }}
          # No step-level DATASET here: a step env overrides the job env,
          # and a steps.* ref to the setup job's family step evaluates
          # EMPTY — harbor died with "Dataset  not found" (run 38126875911).
          # DATASET comes from the bench job's env block above
          # (needs.setup.outputs.dataset).
          AGENT_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.agent-timeout }}
          PROGRESS_EXTENSION: ${{ inputs.progress-extension }}
          # gh-1556 AC2: progress-watch is the bench default on EVERY
          # shard (#1392/#1430) — the gap-aware kill decision replaces
          # the retired byte-growth ladder that guillotined productive
          # trials (TB 2.0 Class C). FA_STALL_GAP_SEC pins the gh-1430
          # invariant (never below fa's 300s stream-idle watchdog +
          # margin — the REG in test_fa_agent_timeout.py reads the Dart
          # source and fails on drift); the abs ceiling is flat 3600s.
          # Removing these exports is the only way back to the legacy
          # ladder (its round-2 byte-for-byte REG stays green).
          # FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1 is required with the watch: without
          # it ProgressWatch degenerates to the flat base cap (the watch
          # only arms its gap-aware decision under the extension).
          FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION: '1'
          FA_STALL_GAP_SEC: '360'
          FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC: '3600'
          # shard task names: dataset dir names, no whitespace — safe to word-split.
          SHARD_TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # gh-1503 defense-in-depth behind the setup preflight: the
          # resolved key env var must carry the selected provider's key
          # (indirect expansion — the name came from the resolve step).
          provider_key="${FA_PROVIDER_KEY_ENV:?resolve step did not run}"
          provider_key_value="${!provider_key}"
          [ -n "$provider_key_value" ] || { echo "::error::provider key env $provider_key is empty — the selected provider's bench secret is not set"; exit 1; }
          if [ "$ENV_TYPE" = modal ]; then
            [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_ID" ] && [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET" ] || { echo '::error::Modal secrets are not set'; exit 1; }
          fi
          # fa_agent.py ships the key into the container base64-encoded; GitHub
          # auto-masks only the raw value, so mask the base64 form too.
          echo "::add-mask::$(printf %s "$provider_key_value" | base64 -w0)"
          args=()
          for t in $SHARD_TASKS; do args+=(-i "$t"); done
          # Issue #1122 knobs, same env contract as bench.yml (shared
          # bench/fa_agent_timeout.py). gh-1556 AC2: the watch knobs now
          # ride the step env block on every shard (progress-watch is the
          # bench default), so the adapter always supervises — only
          # removing those exports restores the unsupervised run. The
          # inputs below stay meaningful ON TOP of the watch defaults:
          # an explicit agent-timeout clips the watch ceiling to base x4
          # (the pre-PR ladder semantics — under the watch the abs
          # ceiling is the cap that actually kills a progressing trial),
          # and an explicit progress-extension: false unsets the
          # step-env extension. With both inputs empty the step-env
          # watch values rule unchanged.
          # A ceiling beyond a task's declared cap is
          # clipped by harbor's own per-task timeout (min of the two wins).
          if [ -n "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" ]; then
            case "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" in *[!0-9]*)
              echo '::error::agent-timeout must be integer seconds'; exit 1;; esac
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="$AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            # gh-1556 rework: without this clip an operator-set base cap
            # would be silently ignored — under watch+extension the abs
            # ceiling alone bounds a progressing trial (base_sec is only
            # consulted with the extension off).
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"
          fi
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            ''|0|1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on|false|FALSE|False|no|off) ;;
            *) echo "::error::progress-extension must be boolean (true/false), got '$PROGRESS_EXTENSION'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            # gh-1556 rework: the step env exports FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1
            # (the watch default) — an explicit false must still win by
            # unsetting it, otherwise the input is a silent no-op.
            false|FALSE|False|no|off) unset FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION;;
            1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on) export FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1;;
          esac
          # Pinned --job-name: one jobs/<name>/ dir per shard, so the summary
          # job's downloads cannot collide on harbor's timestamped default.
          # The family label keys results per dataset version (fa-4.0-*
          # matches the historical 4.0 names exactly).
          .bench-venv/bin/harbor run -d "$DATASET" -a fa_agent:FaAgent \

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only

class DeadlineEnvTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1556 AC7: FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS for fa's deadline awareness.

    The deadline comes ONLY from the adapter's own kill cap minus a
    wrap-up margin — never invented; with no adapter cap (no knobs) the
    export is absent and fa's deadline awareness stays off.
    """

    def test_no_knobs_means_no_deadline(self):
        self.assertIsNone(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(None, 1_700_000_000_000)
        )
        self.assertEqual(fa_agent_timeout.deadline_env_from(clean_env_all()), {})

    def test_watch_mode_deadline_is_abs_ceiling_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        # 3600s abs ceiling - 120s wrap-up margin.
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 3480_000,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_env_from(env, now_ms),
            {"FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS": str(now_ms + 3480_000)},
        )

    def test_legacy_extension_deadline_is_hard_ceiling_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="600", FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        # Hard ceiling = 600 * 4 = 2400s; minus 120s margin.
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 2280_000,
        )

    def test_flat_cap_deadline_is_base_minus_margin(self):
        env = clean_env_all(FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="600")
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 480_000,
        )

    def test_tiny_cap_clamps_to_a_remaining_window(self):
        # A 60s cap minus the 120s margin would land in the past — the
        # deadline clamps to a minimal wrap-up window instead of steering
        # fa into an already-expired clock.
        env = clean_env_all(FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="60")
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(knobs, now_ms),
            now_ms + 30_000,
        )

    def test_test_budget_folds_into_the_watch_cap(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        now_ms = 1_700_000_000_000
        self.assertEqual(
            fa_agent_timeout.deadline_epoch_ms(
                knobs, now_ms, test_budget_sec=300.0
            ),
            now_ms + 3780_000,
        )

    def test_audit_records_the_fa_visible_deadline(self):
        env = clean_env_all(
            FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION="1", FA_STALL_GAP_SEC="360"
        )
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs.from_env(env)
        watch = fa_agent_timeout.ProgressWatch(knobs)
        record = audit_dict(knobs, watch, "abs_ceiling", deadline_epoch_ms=42)
        self.assertEqual(record["deadline_epoch_ms"], 42)

    def test_audit_omits_deadline_when_unset(self):
        # No-knob runs keep the pre-gh-1556 audit shape byte-for-byte.
        knobs = TimeoutKnobs(base_sec=120.0)
        ladder = ProgressLadder(knobs)
        record = audit_dict(knobs, ladder, "stall")
        self.assertNotIn("deadline_epoch_ms", record)

          # resolved key env var must carry the selected provider's key

          provider_key_value="${!provider_key}"

          fi

          # auto-masks only the raw value, so mask the base64 form too.

          args=()
          for t in $SHARD_TASKS; do args+=(-i "$t"); done

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.

So the form is: if ceiling set, clip (min), else default to base×4. So:

```bash
export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="${FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC:-$((AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4))}"
export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"

export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( ceiling < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? ceiling : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"

Hmm, but that single line alone doesn't clip when the ceiling is present (3600 < 600*4=2400 would need min → 2400). E.g., AGENT_TIMEOUT=600, ceiling=3600 present → line leaves 3600, but the clip intent is min(3600, 2400)=2400. # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.

          # No step-level DATASET here: a step env overrides the job env,

          # (needs.setup.outputs.dataset).
          AGENT_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.agent-timeout }}
          PROGRESS_EXTENSION: ${{ inputs.progress-extension }}
          # gh-1556 AC2: progress-watch is the bench default on EVERY
          # shard (#1392/#1430) — the gap-aware kill decision replaces
          # the retired byte-growth ladder that guillotined productive
          # trials (TB 2.0 Class C). FA_STALL_GAP_SEC pins the gh-1430
          # invariant (never below fa's 300s stream-idle watchdog +
          # margin — the REG in test_fa_agent_timeout.py reads the Dart
          # source and fails on drift); the abs ceiling is flat 3600s.
          # Removing these exports is the only way back to the legacy
          # ladder (its round-2 byte-for-byte REG stays green).
          # FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1 is required with the watch: without
          # it ProgressWatch degenerates to the flat base cap (the watch
          # only arms its gap-aware decision under the extension).
          FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION: '1'
          FA_STALL_GAP_SEC: '360'
          FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC: '3600'
          # shard task names: dataset dir names, no whitespace — safe to word-split.
          SHARD_TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # gh-1503 defense-in-depth behind the setup preflight: the
          # resolved key env var must carry the selected provider's key
          # (indirect expansion — the name came from the resolve step).
          provider_key="${FA_PROVIDER_KEY_ENV:?resolve step did not run}"
          provider_key_value="${!provider_key}"
          [ -n "$provider_key_value" ] || { echo "::error::provider key env $provider_key is empty — the selected provider's bench secret is not set"; exit 1; }
          if [ "$ENV_TYPE" = modal ]; then
            [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_ID" ] && [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET" ] || { echo '::error::Modal secrets are not set'; exit 1; }
          fi
          # fa_agent.py ships the key into the container base64-encoded; GitHub
          # auto-masks only the raw value, so mask the base64 form too.
          echo "::add-mask::$(printf %s "$provider_key_value" | base64 -w0)"
          args=()
          for t in $SHARD_TASKS; do args+=(-i "$t"); done
          # Issue #1122 knobs, same env contract as bench.yml (shared
          # bench/fa_agent_timeout.py). gh-1556 AC2: the watch knobs now
          # ride the step env block on every shard (progress-watch is the
          # bench default), so the adapter always supervises — only
          # removing those exports restores the unsupervised run. The
          # inputs below stay meaningful ON TOP of the watch defaults:
          # an explicit agent-timeout clips the watch ceiling to base x4
          # (the pre-PR ladder semantics — under the watch the abs
          # ceiling is the cap that actually kills a progressing trial),
          # and an explicit progress-extension: false unsets the
          # step-env extension. With both inputs empty the step-env
          # watch values rule unchanged.
          # A ceiling beyond a task's declared cap is
          # clipped by harbor's own per-task timeout (min of the two wins).
          if [ -n "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" ]; then
            case "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" in *[!0-9]*)
              echo '::error::agent-timeout must be integer seconds'; exit 1;; esac
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="$AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            # gh-1556 rework: without this clip an operator-set base cap
            # would be silently ignored — under watch+extension the abs
            # ceiling alone bounds a progressing trial (base_sec is only
            # consulted with the extension off).
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"
          fi
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            ''|0|1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on|false|FALSE|False|no|off) ;;
            *) echo "::error::progress-extension must be boolean (true/false), got '$PROGRESS_EXTENSION'"; exit 1 ;;

            # gh-1556 rework: the step env exports FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1
            # (the watch default) — an explicit false must still win by
            # unsetting it, otherwise the input is a silent no-op.
            false|FALSE|False|no|off) unset FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION;;
            1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on) export FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1;;
          esac

          # job's downloads cannot collide on harbor's timestamped default.
          # The family label keys results per dataset version (fa-4.0-*
          # matches the historical 4.0 names exactly).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.

ENV_TYPE: ${{ matrix.env }}
          # No step-level DATASET here: a step env overrides the job env,
          # and a steps.* ref to the setup job's family step evaluates
          # EMPTY — harbor died with "Dataset  not found" (run 38126875911).
          # DATASET comes from the bench job's env block above
          # (needs.setup.outputs.dataset).
          AGENT_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.agent-timeout }}
          PROGRESS_EXTENSION: ${{ inputs.progress-extension }}
          # gh-1556 AC2: progress-watch is the bench default on EVERY
          # shard (#1392/#1430) — the gap-aware kill decision replaces
          # the retired byte-growth ladder that guillotined productive
          # trials (TB 2.0 Class C). FA_STALL_GAP_SEC pins the gh-1430
          # invariant (never below fa's 300s stream-idle watchdog +
          # margin — the REG in test_fa_agent_timeout.py reads the Dart
          # source and fails on drift); the abs ceiling is flat 3600s.
          # Removing these exports is the only way back to the legacy
          # ladder (its round-2 byte-for-byte REG stays green).
          # FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1 is required with the watch: without
          # it ProgressWatch degenerates to the flat base cap (the watch
          # only arms its gap-aware decision under the extension).
          FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION: '1'
          FA_STALL_GAP_SEC: '360'
          FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC: '3600'
          # shard task names: dataset dir names, no whitespace — safe to word-split.
          SHARD_TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # gh-1503 defense-in-depth behind the setup preflight: the
          # resolved key env var must carry the selected provider's key
          # (indirect expansion — the name came from the resolve step).
          provider_key="${FA_PROVIDER_KEY_ENV:?resolve step did not run}"
          provider_key_value="${!provider_key}"
          [ -n "$provider_key_value" ] || { echo "::error::provider key env $provider_key is empty — the selected provider's bench secret is not set"; exit 1; }
          if [ "$ENV_TYPE" = modal ]; then
            [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_ID" ] && [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET" ] || { echo '::error::Modal secrets are not set'; exit 1; }
          fi
          # fa_agent.py ships the key into the container base64-encoded; GitHub
          # auto-masks only the raw value, so mask the base64 form too.
          echo "::add-mask::$(printf %s "$provider_key_value" | base64 -w0)"
          args=()
          for t in $SHARD_TASKS; do args+=(-i "$t"); done
          # Issue #1122 knobs, same env contract as bench.yml (shared
          # bench/fa_agent_timeout.py). gh-1556 AC2: the watch knobs now
          # ride the step env block on every shard (progress-watch is the
          # bench default), so the adapter always supervises — only
          # removing those exports restores the unsupervised run. The
          # inputs below stay meaningful ON TOP of the watch defaults:
          # an explicit agent-timeout clips the watch ceiling to base x4
          # (the pre-PR ladder semantics — under the watch the abs
          # ceiling is the cap that actually kills a progressing trial),
          # and an explicit progress-extension: false unsets the
          # step-env extension. With both inputs empty the step-env
          # watch values rule unchanged.
          # A ceiling beyond a task's declared cap is
          # clipped by harbor's own per-task timeout (min of the two wins).
          if [ -n "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" ]; then
            case "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" in *[!0-9]*)
              echo '::error::agent-timeout must be integer seconds'; exit 1;; esac
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="$AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            # gh-1556 rework: without this clip an operator-set base cap
            # would be silently ignored — under watch+extension the abs
            # ceiling alone bounds a progressing trial (base_sec is only
            # consulted with the extension off).
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"
          fi
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            ''|0|1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on|false|FALSE|False|no|off) ;;
            *) echo "::error::progress-extension must be boolean (true/false), got '$PROGRESS_EXTENSION'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            # gh-1556 rework: the step env exports FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1
            # (the watch default) — an explicit false must still win by
            # unsetting it, otherwise the input is a silent no-op.
            false|FALSE|False|no|off) unset FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION;;
            1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on) export FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1;;
          esac
          # Pinned --job-name: one jobs/<name>/ dir per shard, so the summary
          # job's downloads cannot collide on harbor's timestamped default.
          # The family label keys results per dataset version (fa-4.0-*
          # matches the historical 4.0 names exactly).
          .bench-venv/bin/harbor run -d "$DATASET" -a fa_agent:FaAgent \

    def _step_env(self, name: str):
        """One `NAME: 'value'` entry from a step env block (quoted)."""
        m = re.search(rf"^          {re.escape(name)}: '([^']*)'", self.text, re.M)
        return m.group(1) if m else None

    def test_progress_watch_is_the_shard_default(self):
        # gh-1556 AC2: progress-watch (#1392/#1430) is the bench default —
        # every shard exports the watch knobs and the extension flag, so
        # the adapter's kill decision is the gap-aware ProgressWatch.
        # Removing these exports is the only way back to the legacy
        # byte-growth ladder (its round-2 REG stays green).
        self.assertEqual(self._step_env("FA_STALL_GAP_SEC"), "360")
        self.assertEqual(self._step_env("FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC"), "3600")
        self.assertEqual(self._step_env("FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION"), "1")

    def test_watch_knobs_resolve_to_progress_watch_mode(self):
        # The exported values must actually arm the watch: same env
        # contract the adapter consumes (shared bench/fa_agent_timeout.py).
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
        try:
            import fa_agent_timeout
        finally:
            sys.path.remove(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
        knobs = fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env(
            {
                "FA_STALL_GAP_SEC": self._step_env("FA_STALL_GAP_SEC"),
                "FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC": self._step_env(
                    "FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC"
                ),
                "FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION": self._step_env("FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION"),
            }
        )
        self.assertIsNotNone(knobs)
        self.assertTrue(knobs.progress_watch)
        self.assertTrue(knobs.progress_extension)

    def test_stall_gap_never_drops_below_the_watchdog_invariant(self):
        # gh-1430 invariant: the bench stall-gap must stay above fa's
        # stream-idle watchdog (300s) + margin — the workflow value can
        # never drift below the shipped default (the Dart-source REG in
        # test_fa_agent_timeout.py pins the other side).
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
        try:
            import fa_agent_timeout
        finally:
            sys.path.remove(str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
        gap = float(self._step_env("FA_STALL_GAP_SEC"))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(gap, fa_agent_timeout._STALL_GAP_DEFAULT)

    def _shard_run_block(self):
        """The harbor shard step's `run: |` body."""
        run_block = self.text.split("Run harbor (fa agent", 1)[1]
        return run_block.split("run: |", 1)[1].split("Upload harbor job", 1)[0]

    def test_agent_timeout_input_clips_the_watch_ceiling(self):
        # gh-1556 rework review: under the watch the abs ceiling is the
        # cap that actually kills a progressing trial, so an explicit
        # agent-timeout input must clip it to base x4 (pre-PR the legacy
        # ladder did exactly this) — otherwise the tighter cap the
        # operator asked for is silently ignored in favor of the flat
        # 3600s step-env default.
        self.assertIn(
            "FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4",
            self._shard_run_block(),
        )

    def test_progress_extension_input_can_still_turn_the_extension_off(self):
        # gh-1556 rework review: the step env exports FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).

`LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record

ENV_TYPE: ${{ matrix.env }}
          # No step-level DATASET here: a step env overrides the job env,
          # and a steps.* ref to the setup job's family step evaluates
          # EMPTY — harbor died with "Dataset  not found" (run 38126875911).
          # DATASET comes from the bench job's env block above
          # (needs.setup.outputs.dataset).
          AGENT_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.agent-timeout }}
          PROGRESS_EXTENSION: ${{ inputs.progress-extension }}
          # gh-1556 AC2: progress-watch is the bench default on EVERY
          # shard (#1392/#1430) — the gap-aware kill decision replaces
          # the retired byte-growth ladder that guillotined productive
          # trials (TB 2.0 Class C). FA_STALL_GAP_SEC pins the gh-1430
          # invariant (never below fa's 300s stream-idle watchdog +
          # margin — the REG in test_fa_agent_timeout.py reads the Dart
          # source and fails on drift); the abs ceiling is flat 3600s.
          # Removing these exports is the only way back to the legacy
          # ladder (its round-2 byte-for-byte REG stays green).
          # FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1 is required with the watch: without
          # it ProgressWatch degenerates to the flat base cap (the watch
          # only arms its gap-aware decision under the extension).
          FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION: '1'
          FA_STALL_GAP_SEC: '360'
          FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC: '3600'
          # shard task names: dataset dir names, no whitespace — safe to word-split.
          SHARD_TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # gh-1503 defense-in-depth behind the setup preflight: the
          # resolved key env var must carry the selected provider's key
          # (indirect expansion — the name came from the resolve step).
          provider_key="${FA_PROVIDER_KEY_ENV:?resolve step did not run}"
          provider_key_value="${!provider_key}"
          [ -n "$provider_key_value" ] || { echo "::error::provider key env $provider_key is empty — the selected provider's bench secret is not set"; exit 1; }
          if [ "$ENV_TYPE" = modal ]; then
            [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_ID" ] && [ -n "$MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET" ] || { echo '::error::Modal secrets are not set'; exit 1; }
          fi
          # fa_agent.py ships the key into the container base64-encoded; GitHub
          # auto-masks only the raw value, so mask the base64 form too.
          echo "::add-mask::$(printf %s "$provider_key_value" | base64 -w0)"
          args=()
          for t in $SHARD_TASKS; do args+=(-i "$t"); done
          # Issue #1122 knobs, same env contract as bench.yml (shared
          # bench/fa_agent_timeout.py). gh-1556 AC2: the watch knobs now
          # ride the step env block on every shard (progress-watch is the
          # bench default), so the adapter always supervises — only
          # removing those exports restores the unsupervised run. The
          # inputs below stay meaningful ON TOP of the watch defaults:
          # an explicit agent-timeout clips the watch ceiling to base x4
          # (the pre-PR ladder semantics — under the watch the abs
          # ceiling is the cap that actually kills a progressing trial),
          # and an explicit progress-extension: false unsets the
          # step-env extension. With both inputs empty the step-env
          # watch values rule unchanged.
          # A ceiling beyond a task's declared cap is
          # clipped by harbor's own per-task timeout (min of the two wins).
          if [ -n "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" ]; then
            case "$AGENT_TIMEOUT" in *[!0-9]*)
              echo '::error::agent-timeout must be integer seconds'; exit 1;; esac
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="$AGENT_TIMEOUT"
            # gh-1556 rework: without this clip an operator-set base cap
            # would be silently ignored — under watch+extension the abs
            # ceiling alone bounds a progressing trial (base_sec is only
            # consulted with the extension off).
            export FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC="$(( FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC < AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ? FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC : AGENT_TIMEOUT * 4 ))"
          fi
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            ''|0|1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on|false|FALSE|False|no|off) ;;
            *) echo "::error::progress-extension must be boolean (true/false), got '$PROGRESS_EXTENSION'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          case "$PROGRESS_EXTENSION" in
            # gh-1556 rework: the step env exports FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1
            # (the watch default) — an explicit false must still win by
            # unsetting it, otherwise the input is a silent no-op.
            false|FALSE|False|no|off) unset FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION;;
            1|true|TRUE|True|yes|on) export FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1;;
          esac
          # Pinned --job-name: one jobs/<name>/ dir per shard, so the summary
          # job's downloads cannot collide on harbor's timestamped default.
          # The family label keys results per dataset version (fa-4.0-*
          # matches the historical 4.0 names exactly).
          .bench-venv/bin/harbor run -d "$DATASET" -a fa_agent:FaAgent \

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
